definitions.explanation: Japan's most widely read modern novelist, author of {吾輩|わがはい}は{猫|ねこ}である, {坊|ぼ}っちゃん, and こころ. His works are standard reading in Japanese schools, so his name and his characters come up constantly in ordinary conversation about literature and education.

examples.japanese: {夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{国語|こくご}→国語：02739_kokugo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{漱石|そうせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「こころ」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: We read Soseki's Kokoro in Japanese class.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{千円札|せんえんさつ}→千円札：16603_senensatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{夏目漱石|なつめそうせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肖像|しょうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: The old thousand-yen note used a portrait of Natsume Soseki.

examples.japanese: {漱石|そうせき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧になった⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: Soseki was someone who became a writer after working as an English teacher.

notes:
In everyday speech he is usually called just {漱石|そうせき} — the pen name alone — the way English speakers say "Shakespeare." {夏目|なつめ} is the family name and {漱石|そうせき} the pen name.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {漱石|そうせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: Soseki's works
- {漱石|そうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read Soseki
- ⟦{文豪|ぶんごう}→文豪：12989_bungou⟧{漱石|そうせき}: the great writer Soseki

CULTURAL NOTE:
His portrait appeared on the 1,000-yen note from 1984 to 2004, so older speakers may refer to that bill as {漱石|そうせき}. ⟦{坊|ぼ}っちゃん→坊っちゃん：16357_bocchan⟧ (the hot-headed young teacher of his novel) is used as a nickname for a naive, impulsive young man.
